name: Chamundeshwary Temple
alt: Chamundeshwary Temple in the heart of Sakleshpur
description: A small local temple close to the Bage area; suitable for a brief cultural stop.
tip: Dress respectfully and check local access or timings.

name: Agni Gudda
alt: Agni Gudda hill surrounded by greenery
description: A scenic hill known for its distinctive rocky landscape and panoramic views of the surrounding Western Ghats.
tip: Visit during clear weather for the best views. Wear comfortable footwear while exploring.

name: Manjarabad Fort
alt: Manjarabad Fort overlooking the surrounding landscape
description: The famous star-shaped fort built under Tipu Sultan in 1792, with hilltop views and distinctive military architecture.
tip: Visit in daylight; wear grippy shoes for steps and uneven stone.

name: Hole Malleshwara Swamy Temple
alt: Hole Malleshwara Swamy Temple in a riverside setting
description: A riverside temple setting near the Hemavathi River, offering a quieter heritage stop.
tip: Check current temple hours and dress respectfully.

name: Bisle Ghat
alt: Lush green mountain ranges of Bisle Ghat
description: A beautiful mountain pass in the Western Ghats, famous for its dense forests, mist-covered hills and breathtaking valley views.
tip: Visit during clear weather and drive carefully, as the roads can be narrow and slippery during monsoon.

name: Jenukallu Gudda
alt: Jenukallu Gudda hill with panoramic Western Ghats views
description: A picturesque hill viewpoint offering spectacular views of the surrounding mountain ranges, valleys and lush Western Ghats landscape.
tip: Start early for clearer views and check local trekking and access conditions before visiting.

name: Hadlu Waterfall
description: A nature outing often involving a walk through plantation or forest-edge terrain.
tip: Ask locally about permission and trail condition; skip in heavy rain.

name: Manjehalli Falls
description: A popular waterfall stop with lush surroundings and seasonal flow.
tip: Do not climb wet rocks or enter strong water.

name: Magajahalli Abbi Falls
alt: Magajahalli Abbi Falls amid lush greenery
description: A scenic cascade near Devaladakere/Hanbal, often visited for its greenery and water flow.
tip: Ask locally about access, as the approach may involve uneven terrain.

name: Mookanamane Abbi Falls
alt: Mookanamane Abbi Falls in a scenic setting
description: A more adventurous waterfall outing with uneven terrain and a downhill approach in some routes.
tip: Check trail difficulty locally; not ideal in heavy rain or for anyone with mobility limitations.

name: Coffee plantation walk
alt: Coffee plantation walk through lush greenery
description: Learn about coffee, pepper and local plantation life through a hosted walk.
tip: Book in advance; private estates do not allow unrestricted entry.
